item.title: Haleigh Was Missing. A Cinder Block Held The Door Open
item.description: Five-year-old Haleigh Cummings disappeared from her Satsuma, Florida, home in February 2009, with the back door reportedly propped open by a cinder block. Investigators later classified the case as a homicide, but Haleigh remains missing and no one has been charged in her disappearance.

item.title: Police Suspected The Missing Father Until They Found Him
item.description: When Elaine Dardeen and her two children were found murdered near Ina, Illinois, in November 1987, investigators initially suspected her missing husband, Keith. His body was discovered a mile away the next day. Despite a later confession from serial killer Tommy Lynn Sells, the murders remain unsolved.

item.title: He Was Found Inside A Rolled-Up School Gym Mat
item.description: Kendrick Johnson, 17, was found dead at his Georgia high school in January 2013. Authorities ruled his death accidental, but a family-commissioned autopsy disputed that finding. Federal investigators brought no charges, and a reopened local investigation found no evidence of foul play in 2022.

item.title: An Overlooked Insurance Card Revived Their Cold Case
item.description: Lauria Bible and Ashley Freeman, both 16, vanished in Oklahoma in 1999. Rediscovered files brought investigators back to an overlooked insurance card. Ronnie Busick pleaded guilty to accessory to murder in 2020, but the girls’ remains have never been found.

item.title: The Fake Doctor Behind Relisha Rudd’s School Absences
item.description: Relisha Rudd, 8, disappeared in Washington, D.C., in March 2014. Officials said shelter janitor Kahlil Tatum posed as her doctor to excuse her absences. Authorities believed she had been with Tatum, who was later found dead. Relisha remains missing.

item.title: The Trina Hunt Evidence Canada Wants Kept Secret
item.description: Trina Hunt, 48, was found dead near Hope, British Columbia, in March 2021. Her husband, Iain, faces a charge of indignity to human remains. Canada’s attorney general has sought to withhold evidence on national security grounds. No one has been charged with her killing.
